name: n8n-hubspot-deal-room-mutual-action-plan-generator
description: n8n workflow + Node.js mirror that generates a Mutual Action Plan when a HubSpot deal enters the Proposal / Evaluation stage, back-schedules milestones from the close date, syncs the MAP URL and milestone properties to the deal, and sends weekly Slack nudges for slipped milestones. DRY_RUN and SANDBOX_MODE by default.
